trips.name: Versailles
trips.description: Explore Louis XIV's opulent palace, the Hall of Mirrors and the vast gardens, reached in about 40–60 minutes each way by RER C.

trips.name: Giverny (Monet's House and Gardens)
trips.description: Visit Claude Monet's pink house and water-lily garden, reached by train from Paris Saint-Lazare to Vernon plus a shuttle or bike ride (the site is open roughly April to early November, so it is closed now).

trips.name: Reims and Champagne Houses
trips.geocode_query: Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Reims, Reims, France
trips.description: Tour the coronation cathedral and a Champagne cellar such as Taittinger or Pommery, with a TGV or TER from Paris taking about 45–60 minutes each way.
